How a 19-year-old intern built the growth engine behind this $2B AI company | Hector Serrano Hector Serrano on building Wispr Flow’s paid-UGC machine, hiring young talent over polished resumes, and why the best marketers are “allergic to AI” Lenny Rachitsky Nov 01, 2026 ∙ Paid 90 1 4 Share Transcript Hector Serrano runs one of the most innovative and successful paid growth programs in Silicon Valley. As Head of Content at Wispr Flow, a leading AI voice-to-text tool, he built a roster of 50 creators who drive 500 to 600 paid user-generated content (UGC) ads every month. The creators are paid a cut of ad spend, and the best of them earn over $13,000 a month. It’s a playbook the best DTC brands have used for years, now adapted for SaaS. Hector joined Wispr Flow at 19, before the product had PMF, and over the past year, Wispr Flow has grown revenue 30x and raised at a $2 billion valuation.
